column2: this piece of code has lost its original intent throughout the

Additionally
column2: this patch makes the balance process more lightweight by

column1: removing a pair of shrink/grow operations which are rather expensive for
heavily populated filesystems. This is mainly due to shrink requiring
relocating block groups
column2: involving heavy use of the btree.

column1: The intermediate shrink/grow can fail and leave the filesystem in a
middle state that would need to be changed back by the user.
